all.arm.Arm.from_yaml: no filesystem in a browser: build the config with defaultConfig(overrides) or ArmConfig.fromRaw(raw, product)
all.arm.Arm.PLAN_IN_HELPER: no helper process: moveEe plans cooperatively on the event loop under the same limits (docs/porting.md, Intended differences)
all.config.ArmConfig.from_yaml: no filesystem in a browser: ArmConfig.fromRaw(raw, product) takes the same keys as the YAML
all.kinematics.resolve_urdf: the profile carries the URDF text, not a path
all._product.PACKAGE: Product.packageName holds the npm package name
all._product.PROFILE_DIR: no filesystem: the shipped profile is Product.defaultProfile
all.cameras.Frame.image: an instance field, set by the constructor
all.cameras.Frame.stamp: an instance field, set by the constructor
all.cameras.V4L_BY_PATH: a browser has no device paths; cameras are named by device id or label
all.cameras.V4L_SYSFS: a browser has no device paths; cameras are named by device id or label
all.rig.Rig.load: no filesystem in a browser: Rig.fromRaw(raw, product) takes the rig file's contents
all.rig.Rig.save: no filesystem in a browser: rig.toRaw() gives the contents to store
all.rig.Rig.base: no filesystem: paths in a rig go through RigOptions.files
all.rig.ENV_VAR: no environment variables in a browser
all.rig.default_backend: a browser cannot list device paths; the backend is named in the rig
all.rig.slcan_candidates: a browser cannot list device paths; use browserSerialPorts()
all.rig.only_serial_port: a browser cannot list device paths; use browserSerialPorts()
all.transport.base.CanId: the extended flag is the receive callback's third argument
all.transport.base.create_backend: backends are built from a device or port object; Rig resolves them by name
all.transport.gs_usb.GS_USB_IDS: exported as GS_USB_FILTERS (the WebUSB filter form)
all.transport.gs_usb.list_adapters: listAdapters() in @makermods/arm-core/node; grantedAdapters() in a browser
